audit.recode_to: fixed penultimate, NON-strict (keep rule 10 010 0010...; drop strict=true / add lexical-exception caution). Why: every source, including the deciding one, documents exceptions to penult: Capell & Layard 1980:14-15 (final accent on truncated disyllabic nouns, ni-'al; proclitic attraction 'e lap, 'mwi tsa), Duhamel 2010:19 (nouns ni'mwet, ni'tan stressed finally; grammatical words variable), Lynch 2020:11 ('some environments, and some individual words, where stress falls elsewhere (some antepenultimate, others final)'), Moore 2019:50 (exceptions in -ien/-en words and root+root nouns). Also upgrade the deciding citation to Duhamel 2010:19-20 (Atchin, Praat-checked) with Capell & Layard 1980:14-16 as historical support.

sources.citation: Moore, Alice Margaret. 2019. A Grammar Sketch of Uripiv. MA(Applied) thesis, University of Waikato. 257 pp. hdl.handle.net/10289/12292.
sources.quote: 'The audio data in the Uripiv corpus shows primary stress appearing to fall on the penultimate syllable. McKerras (2001: ms) also describes the primary stress falling on the penultimate syllable of the word. Exceptions to the penultimate syllable stress rule involve complex words and are often: ending in -ien or -en, and some nouns formed by juxtaposing two roots (McKerras, 2001: ms). ... Stress does not appear to be phonemically contrastive in Uripiv. A full analysis of stress is beyond the scope of this project.' (Uripiv dialect of the same languoid, not Atchin.)
sources.note: Corpus-based sketch of the Uripiv dialect (Glottolog-listed); sec. 2.5 confirms penultimate primary stress from audio data and lists McKerras's exception classes (-ien/-en words, root+root nouns).

sources.quote: 'The stress system discussed in this section is based on the analysis of the narrative Le Wortamat ... I took into account the pitch, intensity and length factors as they were reported by Praat software. Stress generally falls on the penultimate syllable of verbs or nouns. When the word ends with a sequence of two vowels, on the pattern V.V(C)#, the stress falls on the penultimate vowel. ...
